blurb: The Science Park Recreation Association (SPRA) is a member owned and operated pool located along Science Park Road in State College. SPRA is a place for friends and family to come, relax, and have a good time. Members of SPRA have access to a clean and well kept swimming environment, a friendly and helpful staff, activities for friends and family, and more.
